summary: Celebrate and play in a fun and imaginative Dollhouse with Friends & Family!
description:
Come home and play with us in my Pretend Home & Family in a fun, imaginative Dollhouse filled with interactive rooms to explore!

A fun digital dollhouse awaits you every time you open the game! Hours of adventures await you as you can interact in over 7 rooms in your very own house!

Create your own World in your very own Home with your Family and Friends!

Play and interact with characters using your imagination! Create stories using over 24 characters, and touch or tap everything in the room to re-create the room of your dreams!

Features include:

- Play in 7 different rooms of the house with your family and friends!
- Play in the Garage, and tinker with the car! Change the color of the vehicle, and place stickers on it, use tools and fuel it up!
- Play in the backyard pool, and hop into one of the fun floats! Have a BBQ and eat some food!
- Play with your siblings upstairs in the bedroom! Jumping on the bed is permitted! Grab toys, draw on the canvas, and have fun playing in your bedroom!
- Play in the Kitchen with all the kitchen tools and bake up something delicious! 

My Pretend Home & Family - Kids Play Town is great fun for all ages! 

Don’t forget to check out our other games in the Pretend Series while enjoying this one!
